newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds need to consolidate, eye 100.31.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds need to consolidate, eye 100.31.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will be restrained before U.S. inflation data on Friday but with a reverse head and shoulders pattern potentially building, there is scope for further gains, technical analysts said.
The contract will aim for the 100.31 area initially.
"It is still possible that a reverse head and shoulders pattern is building, with the neckline around the 38 percent level," Richard Adcock, manager of technical research in London, said.
"It's normally a bullish signal. It signals the end of a down period, but it still needs to be confirmed," he said.
Bunds were quoted at 100.15 at 0649 GMT, up five basis points from Thursday.
Adcock said the neckline would be around the 100.64 area, a 38 percent retracement of this year's decline.
But he said for the pattern to be confirmed, the market needs to continue in its current trading range for the next few days.

Bond friendly March producer prices from the U.S. would give the contract a chance to aim for the 100.31 area, Adcock said. Charts show the contract hitting a high of 100.38 on Thursday and a 100.34 high on April 7.
Independent technical analyst David Wood said support comes in around the 100.00 to 100.07 area, near lows of this week.
"While that's intact the Bunds will start to look as if they are creating a base," Wood told Reuters Financial Television.
He put his upside target at 100.54. Daily charts show this as the high from March 25. He saw good value in the 99.70 area, highs from the beginning of April on daily charts.
June Euromarks were quoted at 96.73, down 0.01 basis point.
